info.name: WanderSync API
info.description: Trip Finance & Travel Sync backend. Flow: Health → Signup/Login (copy token) → everything else uses Bearer token. Socket.io realtime (rooms trip:<id>) is documented in the Realtime folder — voice bursts, chat, presence ride the socket, not REST.

variable.description: Public API host. Local dev: http://localhost:3001
Paste auth token from Auth/Signup or Auth/Signin response (data.token). Sent as Bearer on protected routes.

request.description: DB ping. 200 {ok:true,time} = healthy. 503 {ok:false} = Postgres down — check VM docker.
Create user. Email normalized+unique (case-proof), phone unique (last-10-digits), password min 6. 409 on duplicate. Copies: save data.token into {{token}}.
Login. Email case-proof. Always 401 'Invalid email or password' on failure (never reveals if email exists — standard). Save data.token.
Who owns this token. 200 {user:null} when logged out/expired.
Reset by email. 404 'No account found' when email unknown (explicit by design). Login with new password after.
Revokes ALL sessions for this user (every device/tab/browser). Other devices hit login on next click.
Safe directory (id,email,name,phone,role). password_hash NEVER leaves the API.

item.name: Tables CRUD (generic, session-gated)
item.description: One set of routes serves every table (trips, expenses, todos, documents, settlements, expense_events, chat_messages, invites, members_joined, presence, push_tokens, signals, message_reads, users-read). Trips upsert auto-stamps ownerUid from session when missing (ghost-trip guard). Unknown columns error visibly.

request.description: List with optional ?col=value filters, ?single=true, ?order=col. Example filters trips; swap table name for others.
Insert or update by id. Body = row object (single) or array. users: password_hash stripped server-side.
Body has _filters + columns to set. Example renames the probe trip.
Delete with ?col=value filters. Trips cascade (expenses/chat/etc. go with the trip).

item.name: Voice clips (closed-app PTT store)
item.description: Memory-only, 5-min TTL, max 50 clips. Sender uploads after socket burst; offline members fetch via native service. Server fans out FCM offline-only.

request.description: Body: tripId, voiceUrl (data URL, max 8MB), senderUid, senderName, apiBase. Returns clipId. Triggers offline FCM fan-out.
Native service download. 410 when expired. Replace :clipId with real id from upload.
Tap-to-open fallback: newest unexpired clip for a trip (app plays it on open).

item.name: Admin
item.description: Needs role=admin (admin@wandersync.com seeded). userId = admin's own uid, resolved server-side from token where applicable.

request.description: Admin creates login-ready user (server-side bcrypt — created users CAN log in).
Admin resets any user's password (never sees the old one — bcrypt one-way). Refuses? No — but delete refuses self.
Deletes user + purges owned trips. Refuses self-delete (lockout-proof).

item.name: Realtime (Socket.io — not REST)
item.description: Connect ws to {{baseUrl}} (path /socket.io). Rooms: trip:<tripId> via room:join {tripId,uid,name}. Events: room:leave, bell:ring (ephemeral), voice:burst {tripId,voiceUrl,senderId,senderName,clipId,apiBase} (relayed + ingested for offline FCM, ack {ok}), chat:typing, chat:send {id,tripId,...} (persisted + broadcast + offline FCM fan-out, ack {ok,message}), chat:read, chat:pin, chat:delete. Test with the app (two logins) or a socket.io client — Postman REST cannot speak socket.io handshake reliably.
